messages.content: For households in California, estimate the population median of total annual household income (US dollars per year). Then give a 90% uncertainty interval representing your uncertainty about the value of that population median itself. This is NOT a prediction interval for a randomly selected person or household. Respond with ONLY a JSON object {"median": number, "lo90": number, "hi90": number} in the same units. No other text.
